notes: Non-runtime registry for the AppState transition contract. Runtime controllers are not migrated through this registry in this round.

transitions.guard: Input is valid for the active focus shape and target identity resolves in the current volume namespace.
transitions.allowed_result: Mutate only the active panel selection, viewport, and focus-shape fields required by the key semantics.
transitions.blocked_result: Leave AppState unchanged except for an explicit no-op or constraint message when user-visible clarity is required.
transitions.target_state: AppState.panel[active] records the new tree selection, viewport, and focus shape before render projection.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment panel_generation when selection, viewport, or focus shape changes; volume_generation is unchanged.
side_effects: May request directory payload load when Enter reveals an unlogged directory.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Route HandleDirWindow key dispatch through the canonical transition boundary in a later runtime migration.

transitions.guard: Selected volume identity exists; selecting the already-active volume must preserve its logged topology.
transitions.allowed_result: Bind the active panel to the selected volume and restore that panel's own snapshot for the volume.
transitions.blocked_result: Dismiss or keep the menu according to existing UI semantics without changing panel or volume ownership.
transitions.target_state: AppState.panel[active].volume_key matches the selected volume and uses the panel-local restore record.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment panel_generation when the active panel binds to a different volume; volume_generation changes only for explicit relog/rebuild.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Keep the loaded-volume preservation rule from the specification during runtime migration.

transitions.guard: The key is accepted by the active modal class and no destructive confirmation is being accepted implicitly.
transitions.allowed_result: Clear the modal region and restore the previously recorded panel/session focus shape.
transitions.blocked_result: Keep the modal active and leave underlying panel/volume state unchanged.
transitions.target_state: AppState.modal=none with the suspended panel state restored from its record.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment panel_generation only if restoring the suspended focus shape changes panel-local state.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Modal migration must preserve severity versus neutral dialog routing.

transitions.guard: The active volume namespace is available and rebuild can complete or fail closed.
transitions.allowed_result: Complete rebuild, advance volume_generation, then re-resolve panel snapshots by stable identity keys.
transitions.blocked_result: Keep the previous topology and surface the refresh failure; do not apply partial row-index guesses.
transitions.target_state: AppState.volume[current] has settled topology and panels are rebound or deterministically fallen back.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment volume_generation for any topology or visibility-set change; increment affected panel_generation after rebind/fallback.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Runtime migration must keep restore ordering: rebuild, generation advance, rebind/fallback, render.

transitions.guard: Operation has a valid target volume and will not orphan required panel restore state.
transitions.allowed_result: Update the active panel's volume binding or release the selected volume after safe ownership checks.
transitions.blocked_result: Preserve the existing active volume binding and report the constraint when the operation cannot proceed.
transitions.target_state: AppState session registry and active panel volume binding are consistent.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment panel_generation on binding changes; increment volume_generation on release/relog topology invalidation.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Ensure inactive panels sharing a released volume use deterministic fallback instead of stale pointers.

transitions.guard: Signal handling has only set flags; resize work is executing in the main loop after curses can be called safely.
transitions.allowed_result: Recompute layout geometry and project existing panel state into the new viewport bounds.
transitions.blocked_result: Keep existing authoritative AppState records; if geometry is unusable, render only the safe degraded message surface.
transitions.target_state: AppState.layout records current geometry while panel selection identities remain unchanged.
transitions.generation_effect: Increment panel_generation only when viewport bounds correction changes saved origins; volume_generation is unchanged.
side_effects: Ncurses window recreation in main loop only.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Render reflow must remain projection-only and must not choose a new selection by row math.

transitions.guard: Mutation result is complete and source/target paths are normalized within the intended namespace.
transitions.allowed_result: On success, update affected topology/payload records and rebind panels by identity; on failure, preserve prior authority and report the failure.
transitions.blocked_result: Do not apply partial topology changes; keep panel snapshots and volume_generation unchanged unless a verified rebuild follows.
transitions.target_state: AppState.volume and affected panels reflect the completed mutation or the unchanged pre-mutation state.
transitions.owner: Volume(shared topology) plus YtreeNovaPanel(active) for active selection
transitions.generation_effect: Increment volume_generation for mutations that change topology, identity, or visible payload; increment affected panel_generation after rebind/fallback.
side_effects: Filesystem create/copy/move/delete/chmod-like operations already performed by command layer.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Runtime migration must separate command side effects from AppState commit/rollback metadata.

transitions.guard: Command completion has a final status and any requested refresh/reload boundary is explicit.
transitions.allowed_result: Record outcome message and schedule refresh/rebind only when the command contract declares filesystem impact.
transitions.blocked_result: Preserve panel and volume state while reporting command failure or cancellation.
transitions.target_state: AppState.command=idle with message and optional refresh transition queued.
transitions.generation_effect: No generation change unless a declared follow-up refresh/rebuild or panel focus change occurs.
side_effects: External command execution is outside the AppState commit boundary.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Later runtime boundary should declare whether each command completion queues refresh_rebuild.

transitions.guard: Topology rebuild is settled and stable identity keys are available for re-resolution.
transitions.allowed_result: Re-resolve exact identity or apply the deterministic fallback order, then commit the new panel anchor.
transitions.blocked_result: Fail closed to root visible node only after exact/ancestor/sibling fallbacks are exhausted; never dereference stale pointers.
transitions.target_state: AppState.panel snapshot matches current panel_generation and volume_generation.
transitions.generation_effect: Refresh snapshot generation markers after successful rebind/fallback; volume_generation is read, not advanced, by the callback.
side_effects: May request payload reload for a visible but unloaded file-view anchor.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Use panel_anchor helpers as the canonical restore boundary during runtime migration.

transitions.guard: Authoritative AppState records are settled before rendering begins.
transitions.allowed_result: Compute temporary view projections and flush staged ncurses updates without mutating selection authority.
transitions.blocked_result: Skip or degrade rendering; do not synthesize a new authoritative selection, viewport, or focus shape.
transitions.target_state: Rendered screen reflects AppState; AppState selection and ownership fields are unchanged by projection.
transitions.generation_effect: No panel_generation or volume_generation change from render projection alone.
transitions.notes_follow_up: Audit render paths so temporary projections cannot become restore authority.
